source_refs.note: ii) Diesel Particulate Filter (DPF): a main subheading of 14.14 Strategies used to reduce air pollution, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 317-318.

blocks.text: DPF naye diesel engines mein lagaya jata hai taake exhaust gases se harmful particulate matter (PM) kam nikle. Is ka asal kaam exhaust gases se soot (kalikh) ke particles ko capture (pakarna) aur store (jama) karna hai.
